attachments.insertion_landmark: pharyngeal wall and thyroid cartilage (the cartilaginous larynx is not yet modeled as a skeletal element in this pass -- approximated via the adjacent hyoid attachment region)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The only pharyngeal muscle innervated by CN IX rather than the vagal pharyngeal plexus -- a classic exam fact (all other pharynx/larynx/soft-palate muscles except tensor veli palatini are vagus-innervated).
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
